title: AI芯片营收：超预期36%，先进制程利润惊人，能否带动全
speaker: Stephen Tang

segments.en: Tang our Bloomberg intelligence senior industry analyst is here with us to talk us through your reactions to the numbers and what is driving the strength there in the revenues.
segments.zh: 彭博行业研究高级分析师唐先生与我们一同解读数据，以及营收增长背后的驱动力。

segments.en: Okay the number of the coming in line with market expectation which is explained why the market was basically flat today.
segments.zh: 数据符合市场预期，这也解释了为何今日市场基本持平。

segments.en: But the number itself is growth is like 36% the company's guidance is about 30 for the full year so I think obviously you can say it's better than the company's management guided.
segments.zh: 但实际增长约36%，而公司全年指引约为30%，显然优于管理层预期。

segments.en: But I haven't say that the company has been managing their market expectation pretty tightly based on what they're historically.
segments.zh: 不过，公司历来对市场预期的管理非常严格。

segments.en: So I think the obviously investor might expect them to maybe do some adjustment on their guidance in the coming earnings call.
segments.zh: 因此，投资者可能预期公司在即将到来的财报电话会上调整指引。

segments.en: But for the growth driver clearly AI is a driver and more specifically a lot of AI chips are based on their three and five nanometer knots.
segments.zh: 增长驱动力显然是AI，尤其是许多AI芯片基于其3纳米和5纳米制程。

segments.en: Those are actually highly efficient knots meaning that they generate very good margin for the company.
segments.zh: 这些制程效率极高，为公司带来非常可观的利润率。

segments.en: So the growth there not just supporting the revenue but also supporting the earnings.
segments.zh: 因此，增长不仅支撑营收，也支撑盈利。

segments.en: So all things are actually pretty positive.
